D. 3580.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3580.
Date 10 / 5 / 32.

May 10, 32.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
telegram dated April 28, 1932 which reads as follows:
"Is anything known against Xenia de Silva of
9B Chaupoong Road" Secrim.
The following reply was despatched to-day:
"Xenia de Silva no Police record, letter
follows" Legiron.

Enquiries shew that the woman in question is a
Russian born at Irkutsk, Siberia in 1884. She arrived
in Shanghai in 1921 and in the following year married a
Portuguese named de Silva who died in 1926. From 1927
to 1930 she cohabited with an Englishman (name unknown)
who established her in a boarding house at 9B Chaupoong
Road where well known foreign pickpockets were numbered
amongst her guests.

Mrs. de Silva sold her boarding house on April
19, 1932 and left for Singapore in order, it is
believed, to effect a reconciliation with her former
paramour who left Shanghai for Singapore in 1930.

1932年5月10日。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1932年4月28日的电报，内容如下：
“关于兆丰路9B号的克谢尼娅·达席尔瓦，警方是否掌握任何不利记录 Secrim。”
今日已发出如下回复：
“克谢尼娅·达席尔瓦无警方记录，后续函件跟进 Legiron。”

经查，该女子系俄罗斯人，1884年生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克。她于1921年抵达上海，次年嫁给一名名为达席尔瓦的葡萄牙人，后者于1926年去世。1927年至1930年间，她与一名英国人（姓名不详）同居，该英国人在兆丰路9B号为她开设了一所寄宿公寓，其住客中包括一些知名的外籍扒手。

达席尔瓦夫人于1932年4月19日出售了其寄宿公寓，并前往新加坡，据信是为了与其前情夫和解，该男子曾于1930年离开上海前往新加坡。

Date May 9. 1932
10 / 5 / 32

Subject (in full) Mrs Xenia de Silva

Made by D.S.Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the D.D.O ("D") report dated
April 30, 1932 on the subject of Xenia de Silva, further enquiries
show that this individual is a Russian who was born in 1884 at Ir-
kutsk, Siberia. She arrived in Shanghai in 1921. In 1922 she mar-
ried one De Silva, a Portuguese, who subsequently died in 1926.
From 1927 till 1930 she cohabited with an unknown Englishman who
supported her and established her in a boarding-house. Following
the Englishman's departure for Singapore in 1930 Mrs de Silva
went to Tsingtao where, it is reported, she worked as a dancing
partner for some time. Her paramour, it is believed, was informed
of this fact as well as of her alleged misconduct, and accordingly
withdrew his financial support and ceased understanding cohabiting with her.

On April 19, 1932 Mrs de Silva sold her boarding-house
at No 96 Chaoufoong Road for $ 2.000 and left for Singapore, in or-
der, it is believed, to effect a reconciliation with her former
paramour.

There is nothing in Municipal Police records to her
detriment, but it is known that certain foreign pickpockets occasion-
ally stayed at her boarding-house.

[Signature]
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch

S.p. (Crime)
Information.
[Signature]
O. i/c Sp. Br.
MAY 10 1932

主题（全称）克谢尼娅·达席尔瓦夫人

由 D.S.切列姆尚斯基制作 转交人 [签名]

关于1932年4月30日有关克谢尼娅·达席尔瓦的D.D.O（“D”处）报告，进一步调查显示，此人系俄罗斯人，1884年生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克。她于1921年抵达上海。1922年，她嫁给一名名为德席尔瓦的葡萄牙人，后者随后于1926年去世。从1927年到1930年，她与一名身份不明的英国人同居，该男子供养她并为她开设了一所寄宿公寓。在该英国人于1930年前往新加坡后，达席尔瓦夫人前往青岛，据报她在那里做了一段时间的舞伴。据信，她的情夫得知了这一事实以及她涉嫌的不端行为，因此撤回了经济支持，并停止了与她的同居关系。

1932年4月19日，达席尔瓦夫人以2,000美元的价格出售了位于兆丰路96号的寄宿公寓，并前往新加坡，据信是为了与其前情夫和解。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何对其不利的记录，但已知某些外籍扒手偶尔曾住在她的寄宿公寓中。

[签名]
D.S.

特别科科长

刑事科警司。
情报。
[签名]
特别科科长
1932年5月10日

Date April 29th, 1932

Subject (in full) Enquiries re Russian female Xenia De Silva.

Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by .................... Supt: Conduit.

Sir :
Xenia De Silva a Russian female was married to a Portuguese named De Silva (now deceased). She resided at No. 9B Chaoufoong Road. Well known pickpockets also stayed there. She had a sweetheart an Englishman who left Shanghai and obtained a situation in Singapore or India.
On the 12th April 1932 Xenia De Silva sold No. 9B Chaoufoong Road for $2,000.00 to a Russian named Telenin. Xenia De Silva then left Shanghai with the intention of joining her lover the Englishman (name unknown).
This female has no record at Wayside.

R. Conduit.
D.D.O. "D" Division.

D. C. (Crime). $2. For attention please
J.M.
29/4/32
D.I. Unknown directly
